function.description: This function sets a source data object for a given clipboard. If the clipboard already has a source data object, it releases it before setting the new one. If the data object is not null, it adds a reference to it, sets it as the source data object for the clipboard, and sets the clipboard formats.

parameters.name: clipbrd
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the clipboard where the source data object will be set.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: This is a pointer to the data object that will be set as the source data object for the clipboard.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: clipbrd_uninitialize
function.description: This function uninitializes the clipboard by releasing the reference to the data object and destroying the clipboard window.

parameters.name: void
parameters.description: This function does not take any parameters.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything.

function.name: clipbrd_destroy
function.description: This function destroys the clipboard by releasing the associated memory and setting the global clipboard object to NULL.

parameters.name: void
parameters.description: This function does not take any parameters.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value.

function.name: clipbrd_wndproc
function.description: This function is a callback for a window that processes clipboard-related messages. It handles three types of messages: WM_RENDERFORMAT, WM_RENDERALLFORMATS, and WM_DESTROYCLIPBOARD. For WM_RENDERFORMAT, it renders a specific clipboard format. For WM_RENDERALLFORMATS, it renders all available clipboard formats. For WM_DESTROYCLIPBOARD, it clears the source data object.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: A handle to the window.

parameters.name: message
parameters.description: The message to be processed.

parameters.name: wparam
parameters.description: Additional message-specific information.

parameters.name: lparam
parameters.description: Additional message-specific information.

function.return_type: LRESULT, represents the result of the message processing. It returns 0 if the message is handled, otherwise it calls and returns the result of DefWindowProcW function.

function.name: create_clipbrd_window
function.description: This function creates a new clipboard window, registers it and returns its handle.
function.return_type: HWND, which represents the handle to the created clipboard window

function.name: set_dataobject_format
function.description: This function allocates a global memory block, copies the HWND into it, and then sets the clipboard data to this memory block. If any step fails, it cleans up and returns an error code.

parameters.name: hwnd
parameters.description: A handle to a window. This is the data that will be put on the clipboard.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which is a type used to represent error codes. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails to allocate memory, it returns E_OUTOFMEMORY. If it fails to set the clipboard data, it returns CLIPBRD_E_CANT_SET.

function.name: OleSetClipboard
function.description: This function sets the clipboard to the provided IDataObject. It handles the process of opening the clipboard, emptying it, setting the data object, and closing the clipboard. If any of these steps fail, it cleans up by setting the data object to NULL.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: This is the data object that will be set to the clipboard.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. It will return specific error codes if the clipboard cannot be opened, emptied, or closed, or if the data object cannot be set.

function.name: OleGetClipboard
function.description: This function retrieves the current contents of the clipboard.

parameters.name: obj
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to an IDataObject interface. This parameter is used to return the interface pointer.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function call. It returns S_OK if the function is successful, E_INVALIDARG if the argument is invalid, E_OUTOFMEMORY if there is not enough memory to complete the operation, or other error codes for different failure scenarios.

function.name: OleFlushClipboard
function.description: This function flushes the clipboard and updates the clipboard viewer window. It also releases the data object that was placed on the clipboard by the OleSetClipboard function.

parameters.name: void
parameters.description: This function does not take any parameters.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the success or failure of the function. It returns S_OK if the function is successful, E_FAIL if OLE is not initialized, CLIPBRD_E_CANT_OPEN if the clipboard cannot be opened, or CLIPBRD_E_CANT_CLOSE if the clipboard cannot be closed.

function.name: OleIsCurrentClipboard
function.description: This function checks if the provided data object is the current clipboard.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: The data object to be checked if it is the current clipboard

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation, S_OK if the provided data object is the current clipboard, S_FALSE otherwise
